title: fxkit
author: irpina
description: What the Digitone mk1's effect mods share: one effect at a time has the audio (exclusive, the synths muted), with a mixer around it (the inputs' levels and pans, mix, balance, volume, width), two LFOs with the stock LFO's rates and waves aimed only at its knobs, and p-locks kept in the pattern, in one track's lock table (T4 unless the effect's SETUP says otherwise), that play on their steps and save with the pattern. Each effect stays a mod of its own, with its own Mod Menu entry and page; fxkit draws its MIXER and LFO pages and keeps its LOCK mode. On its own it adds nothing to the screen. Needs core-dn1 4.1.
